lean.name: UpperTheory.V.Z.Kato.Final.zetaUr
lean.note: For the specified ordinary newform and attached two-dimensional representation, the Kato argument supplies an integral cocycle unramified away from $\ell$. At $\ell$ its projection to the ordinary quotient is nontrivial in cohomology, and at suitable auxiliary primes it has lifts satisfying the stated Frobenius congruence.
